WITH RECURSIVE links(cr, pack_id) AS (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member), vdisp(target, code, wg_label) AS (SELECT ds.target, ds.code, m.label FROM disposition ds JOIN resolution r ON r.id = ds.resolution_id JOIN meeting m ON r.meeting_id IN (m.id, m.label) WHERE lower(ds.evidence_status) LIKE '%verified%' AND lower(ds.evidence_status) NOT LIKE '%unverified%' AND lower(ds.evidence_status) NOT LIKE '%not%verified%' AND (lower(ds.scope) LIKE '%whole%' OR lower(ds.scope) LIKE '%entire%' OR lower(ds.scope) IN ('document','doc','full','full_document','all')) AND (m.wg IS NULL OR m.wg LIKE '%3%')), seed(k) AS (SELECT 'R3-212932' UNION SELECT id FROM document WHERE number = 'R3-212932' OR id = 'R3-212932' UNION SELECT number FROM document WHERE (number = 'R3-212932' OR id = 'R3-212932') AND number IS NOT NULL), later(k) AS (SELECT r.later FROM revision r WHERE r.earlier IN (SELECT k FROM seed) UNION SELECT r.later FROM revision r JOIN later lt ON r.earlier = lt.k) SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(d.number, d.id) AS final_document, v.code AS disposition, p.pack_number AS cr_pack FROM later lt JOIN document d ON lt.k IN (d.id, d.number) JOIN vdisp v ON v.target IN (d.id, d.number) JOIN links l ON l.cr IN (d.id, d.number) JOIN cr_pack p ON l.pack_id IN (p.id, p.pack_number) WHERE d.id NOT IN (SELECT k FROM seed) AND COALESCE(d.number, '') NOT IN (SELECT k FROM seed)
